comment: The acceptance suites, and the only place their membership is written down.
hack/verify-kubernetes-support.go emits the CI matrix from this file and
refuses it unless every phase hack/e2e-kind.sh runs belongs to exactly one
suite, so a suite that lost a phase is a failed check rather than a green
run that proved less. hack/e2e-kind.sh reads the same file to decide which
phases E2E_SUITE names.
The partition follows the dependencies and the measurements on #157. A
suite runs against its own cluster, so phases that share mutable state stay
together: the CRD upgrade and the uninstall that follows it, the schema
faults and their shared watches. Reference data uses separate databases
and has no migration prerequisite. PostgreSQL reference data shares the
sources job; MySQL reference data shares certificates. High
availability belongs with the upgrade rather than with the other
control-plane phases, because it asserts what an upgrade leaves behind:
the Resolve metric sources of the release it replaced. The control-plane
contract supplies the suspended schema and approval the schema fault
phase reads. MySQL and external PostgreSQL stay with faults because their
closing assertions must still hold afterward. They own schema-faults;
the ordinary PostgreSQL, plan-size, and admission rows
remain in data-plane.
A suite has to finish inside the 90-minute job limit with room for a slow
runner. On CI run 42372668755 data-plane passed that limit, three more of
the nine suites this file then held came within five minutes of it and a
fifth within ten. So a suite splits where its rows own their state: the
ConfigMap and Git sources read their own databases and leave data-plane
for sources; the schema executor rows roll the manager and stand up their
own fixtures and watches in schema-runtime; each engine's migration
authority rows get a suite of their own; and the migration rows that
create their own migration and database, from late dispatch to the
rebuild drill, leave the lifecycle that reads the engine's own migration
for migration-faults. A phase split this way publishes every artifact it
reads. After that split lifecycle still came within fourteen minutes of
the limit, so PostgreSQL reference data, which reads only the prepared
namespace and a database of its own, moved from lifecycle to sources.
The migration path runs one engine per suite. Reference-data acceptance
uses the prepared namespace, registry and databases. Plan-store alerting
shares the certificate monitoring setup rather than extending the
lifecycle job that already holds the upgrade fault window. Moving
schema faults to their own cluster lets these phases overlap the longer
data-plane and lifecycle jobs without repeating acceptance.
prepare names a phase a suite runs for its prerequisites rather than for
its own acceptance. A phase with a preparation mode runs in it; a phase
without one runs in full, which is how a suite borrows the objects another
phase's acceptance leaves behind -- the certificate rotation reaches the
approval the control-plane contract creates, and repeating that phase for
forty seconds is cheaper than either copying its fixtures or tying the two
suites together. The certificates suite borrows assert for the approval
that the alerting certificate-expiry probe updates. Alerting creates its
own native producer resources, so it does not wait for full migration and
reference-data acceptance. The migration phases run in the
namespace the data plane stands up -- its registry Service, its databases
and its admission fixtures -- so that phase runs in preparation mode there,
which creates those prerequisites and executes no operation under test.
Preparation is not coverage: a phase is covered only where it is listed in
phases, and the completeness check counts it there and nowhere else.
isolationWorker gives a suite's cluster a second worker node, labelled and
tainted so that only the Pods a proof places there run on it. The migration
fault phases cut that node off from the API server in the middle of an
Apply; the migration and schema fault phases hold its log responses
unfinished. Cutting off
the worker everything else runs on would take the manager, the
databases and the registry down with it. A suite declares it exactly when
it runs a phase that isolates a node beyond its preparation boundary, and
make e2e with no suite named gets it whenever any suite does.
